The claim states that Ukrainian attacks on fuel supplies in Russian-occupied Crimea have led officials to suspend civilian gasoline sales. This indicates a direct consequence of military actions impacting daily life and infrastructure.

Officials in Russian-occupied Crimea suspended civilian gasoline sales Sunday following intensified Ukrainian attacks on fuel supplies. Governor Sergey Aksyonov cited overnight strikes that killed four and wounded 28, halting sales to non-state entities.
